gpu.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

interpretation: nvidia-smi reported a flat 68036 MiB device-resident allocation before and throughout inference. The service therefore appears to reserve or retain a roughly 66.44 GiB CUDA memory pool and reuse it for the probe batches. This measurement establishes the externally visible device occupancy, not the live tensor high-water mark inside the allocator. PyTorch allocator instrumentation in the server would be required to separate reserved from actively allocated memory.
